summary: Group 1 Automotive filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual meeting and a charter amendment lowering the threshold for stockholders to call a special meeting from board-only to holders of at least 25% of outstanding shares. The filing discloses director elections and ratification of auditor. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is present. This is a routine governance update with no special situation event.
